article.title_en: ZoomInfo brings MCP and API access into Snowflake
article.summary: ZoomInfo於10月30日公布，在Snowflake提供MCP及API接入，讓企業查詢公司、聯絡人及購買訊號。
article.summary_en: ZoomInfo’s October 30 announcement brings MCP and API access to Snowflake for company, contact and buying-signal queries.
article.why: B2B團隊可把外部資料與倉庫內商機資料對照，先界定代理可讀範圍。
article.why_en: B2B teams can compare external intelligence with warehouse opportunities while defining agent access.

highlights: CoWork及Cortex Agents可讀取外部商業資料。
接入採OAuth 2.0並沿用ZoomInfo角色權限；Cortex開通需Snowflake管理員批准。
highlights_en: CoWork and Cortex Agents can use external business intelligence.
OAuth 2.0 inherits ZoomInfo roles; Cortex exposure requires Snowflake admin approval.
article.detail:
ZoomInfo於10月30日公布，在Snowflake提供MCP及API接入，讓企業查詢公司、聯絡人及購買訊號。

CoWork及Cortex Agents可讀取外部商業資料。

接入採OAuth 2.0並沿用ZoomInfo角色權限；Cortex開通需Snowflake管理員批准。

B2B團隊可把外部資料與倉庫內商機資料對照，先界定代理可讀範圍。

以唯讀帳戶研究試行，核對資料授權及稽核紀錄。

需同時具備Snowflake及ZoomInfo訂閱；公告未證明資料準確率、銷售增長或自動投放能力。
article.detail_en:
ZoomInfo’s October 30 announcement brings MCP and API access to Snowflake for company, contact and buying-signal queries.

CoWork and Cortex Agents can use external business intelligence.

OAuth 2.0 inherits ZoomInfo roles; Cortex exposure requires Snowflake admin approval.

B2B teams can compare external intelligence with warehouse opportunities while defining agent access.

Pilot read-only account research and check data permissions and audit logs.

Snowflake access and a ZoomInfo subscription are required. The release proves no accuracy rate, sales lift or automatic campaign activation.
